meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在容器代理系统出问题时会按 NanoClaw 调试指南行事:检查错误日志、会话数据库、挂载配置等,并给出对应的排查命令和修复建议。也可用来解释容器系统如何工作。
howto.when: 当容器代理不工作、启动失败、出现认证问题,或你想了解容器系统工作原理时,Claude 会进入调试流程。

say.text: 容器没回复,用 debug 技能帮我查日志。
say.note: Claude 会先看 error 日志和会话数据库。

say.text: 报错 No adapter for channel type,怎么修?
say.note: Claude 会检查是否运行了两个服务实例。

say.text: 帮我看看消息进没进容器。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude uses the NanoClaw debugging guide when container agent issues arise: it inspects logs, session DBs, mounts, duplicate instances, and gives diagnostic commands and fixes. It can also explain the container system.
howto.when_en: Claude enters the debugging flow when container agents are not working, fail to start, have authentication problems, or when you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container isn't replying. Use the debug skill to check logs.
say_en.note: Claude will check the error log and session DBs.

say_en.text: I got 'No adapter for channel type'. How do I fix it?
say_en.note: Claude will check for duplicate service instances.

say_en.text: Help me check whether the message reached the container.
say_en.note: Claude will query the inbound and outbound DBs.
